project_type: Greenfield Java 17 / Spring Boot 3.x REST API — software HSM emulator
build_system: Maven 3.9 — standard lifecycle: compile → test (Surefire, unit tests) → verify (Failsafe, integration tests + JaCoCo gate). Use './mvnw' wrapper. Key quirk: Testcontainers starts its own Docker Postgres — no external service block needed in CI; Docker daemon must be running.
test_framework: JUnit 5 + Mockito for unit tests (Surefire, 'mvn test'); Testcontainers PostgreSQL module for integration tests (Failsafe, 'mvn verify'). AbstractIntegrationTest base class with static shared PostgreSQLContainer + @DynamicPropertySource. Test tags: @Tag("security"), @Tag("crypto"), @Tag("integration").
verification_instructions: 1. Ensure Docker is running (needed for Testcontainers). 2. Run: mvn --batch-mode verify. 3. Confirm BUILD SUCCESS. 4. Confirm JaCoCo gate passes (line >= 80%, branch >= 75%). 5. Check target/site/jacoco/index.html for coverage report. For unit tests only: mvn test. For security-tagged tests: mvn test -Dgroups=security.
snapshot_or_generated_files: target/site/jacoco/ (coverage HTML+XML) — generated by 'mvn verify'. Not checked in. target/surefire-reports/ and target/failsafe-reports/ — test results. Not checked in.
environment_constraints: HSM_MASTER_PASSPHRASE environment variable must be set before running the app (not tests — tests use a fixed test passphrase). Docker must be running for integration tests. PostgreSQL is NOT pre-installed — Docker Compose for local dev, Testcontainers for tests. Never use H2. Java 17 only — no Java 21 features.
contribution_requirements: All dependencies must be pinned to exact versions in pom.xml — no open ranges. Bouncy Castle (bcprov-jdk18on) is used ONLY for Argon2id token hashing in TokenService. NEVER use Bouncy Castle for any other cryptographic operation. NEVER write custom cryptography. NEVER log or return raw key bytes. NEVER distinguish 'unknown user' vs 'wrong token' in 401 responses (identical body). Zero byte[] arrays after use in finally blocks. All @PreAuthorize on service methods, not controllers. JaCoCo gates: line >= 80%, branch >= 75% — enforced in 'mvn verify'.
key_patterns: Package root: com.example.hsm. Sub-packages: config/, controller/, service/ (with service/crypto/ and service/audit/), repository/, entity/, dto/, exception/. Integration tests extend AbstractIntegrationTest. Test classes: *Test for unit, *IT for integration. Flyway migrations in src/main/resources/db/migration/ named V{N}__{description}.sql. DTOs are immutable records or have no-arg + all-arg constructors. Entities use @Column(columnDefinition = "bytea") for binary fields. toString() on HsmKey explicitly excludes wrappedDek/ivDek/authTagDek. AuditService uses REQUIRES_NEW propagation for DENIED/ERROR outcomes so they always commit even when primary transaction rolls back.
directory_structure: g:\hsm\ — workspace root. docs/ — spec documents (requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md). src/main/java/com/example/hsm/ — application source. src/main/resources/ — application.yml, db/migration/ Flyway SQLs. src/test/java/com/example/hsm/ — test sources mirroring main structure. docker-compose.yml — local Postgres. .github/workflows/ci.yml — CI pipeline. .agents/tasks/ — FEAT artifacts (NOT part of the worktree commit).
